title: Traceable AI Answers for Public Data: Event Recording & Field Guide
content:
This online event marked the conclusion of the Traceable AI Answers for Public Data project under the AI Learning Labs initiative, showcasing AI integration with open data portals. You can now watch the full event recording and explore all presentation materials.

The post Traceable AI Answers for Public Data: Event Recording & Field Guide first appeared on Open Knowledge Blog.
